result.brief: 提出运动对齐的潜在动力学作为跨具身表征，结合潜在动力学模型与混合Transformer世界动作模型，从人类视频学习可执行的世界模型。
result.reason: Proposes motion-aligned latent dynamics as embodiment-agnostic representation bridging human video priors to actions, with latent dynamics model and MoT world action model—directly a video world model and representation contribution.
